svg.text: THE LABYRINTH IS NOT A MAZE
Plate XII — one path, no choices: a seven-circuit labyrinth, its seed, its thread, and its impostor
A. The walk itself — seven circuits, walls in ink, the thread in vermilion
Enter at the south dot. You cannot get lost; you can only get tired.
B. The seed — cross, corners, dots
C. The clew — the ball that became “clue”
